origin.description: Test whether the locale can show UTF-8.
origin.details: On Windows the function reports true outside the C locale.

translation.description: True when LC_CTYPE contains UTF-8. The C locale is false.
translation.details: This machine's locale is UTF-8, so both sides are true.
translation.example:
from utf8 import output_utf8
print("TRUE" if output_utf8() else "FALSE")
